description: Copy a video or image from a public http(s) link into the user's oriiion account (server-side, up to 200MB video / 25MB image, 5 minute limit) and get a mediaId + permanent URL. Google Drive and Dropbox share links work when shared as 'Anyone with the link'. Links to private networks, localhost or cloud metadata addresses are refused. Accepted: video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/webm, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif (decided by the file's bytes). Output: { mediaId, status: 'ready', url, kind, contentType, sizeBytes, filename }.

filename.description: Optional filename to store it under

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the video or image file

name: import_media_from_url

contentType.description: Content type detected from the stored bytes

mediaId.description: Opaque id (med_…) — pass it to create_post_from_video

url.description: Permanent public URL of the stored file

title: Import Media From URL
